title: Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Tuned for all-terrain exploration, the Arai Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow is purpose-built for adventure riders tackling varied weather and challenging backcountry trails across highway asphalt and backcountry gravel. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell tips the scales at 1415g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~90 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

product_details.description: Designed for high-speed touring stability and comfort.

sizing_fit.fit_notes: Arai's signature 'Perfect Fit' system; generally runs true to size with a slightly narrow cheekbone profile compared to modulars, requiring precise sizing for optimal comfort. Designed specifically for Intermediate Oval head shapes.

technical_analysis: Features Complex Laminate Construction (CLC) with PB-SNC2 peripheral belt reinforcement and R75 smooth shell geometry for glance-off impact energy redirection paired with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports. The interior utilizes One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining with pre-shaped speaker cutouts for seamless Bluetooth comms integration.
marketing_description: Experience the Arai Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow: combining Japan 🇯🇵 craftsmanship with VAS (Variable Axis System) shield mechanism with dual-latch shield lock and IC Duct 5 ventilation intake ports and One-piece multi-density EPS liner with Eco-Pure anti-microbial removable Dry-Cool interior lining. Perfect for riders who demand uncompromised safety and aero-acoustic comfort.
yoast_title: Arai Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow: Specs, Real-World Review & Price Guide
yoast_metadesc: In-depth review of the Arai Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow. Tested shell weight, ECE/DOT safety rating, noise dB quietness, and fitment guide for Intermediate Oval heads.

introduction: Positioned in Arai's Full Face lineup, the Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow brings Japanese engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, Snell M2020, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Arai Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow represents Arai's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~90 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking an Advanced Multi-Composite (Carbon-Aramid-Glass / AIM+) Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Arai Contour-X Fluorescent Yellow delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
